Hon.

Sec. of the Romsey [Band of Mercy](/organisation/265)

She married (1876) her cousin Commander Thomas Suckling, R. N., of Highwood, Romsey, and was deeply involved in animal welfare charities.

They were descended from Nelson\'s maternal uncle.
